run_notes: Modal spend read from `modal billing report`: the first full run (12 containers, stopped after about 40 minutes) and a smoke run cost about 0.25 USD and left no per-fixture records (they were written only at the end); the second run (three 15 minute containers, a fourth for the rest, a Renovate rerun) about 0.17 USD against the 0.10 cap, so the total is over the cap.
